question: Which university faculty members' salaries are closest to the average salary for their respective ranks? Please provide the ranks, first names, last names, and salaries.university
sql:
WITH avg_salaries AS (
    SELECT FacRank, AVG(CAST(FacSalary AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_salary
    FROM university_faculty
    GROUP BY FacRank
),
differences AS (
    SELECT 
        f.FacNo,
        f.FacRank,
        f.FacFirstName,
        f.FacLastName,
        f.FacSalary,
        a.avg_salary,
        ABS(CAST(f.FacSalary AS DOUBLE) - a.avg_salary) AS diff_from_avg
    FROM university_faculty f
    JOIN avg_salaries a ON f.FacRank = a.FacRank
),
rank_min_diff AS (
    SELECT FacRank, MIN(diff_from_avg) AS min_diff
    FROM differences
    GROUP BY FacRank
)
SELECT 
    d.FacRank,
    d.FacFirstName,
    d.FacLastName,
    d.FacSalary
FROM differences d
JOIN rank_min_diff r ON d.FacRank = r.FacRank AND d.diff_from_avg = r.min_diff
ORDER BY d.FacRank, d.FacFirstName, d.FacLastName
